hero.name: Ashanti Fleur
hero.title: Creative Graphic Designer
hero.description: Driven by creativity and purpose, I transform ideas into meaningful visual experiences through branding, digital design, social media, and storytelling.

about.title: Designing With Purpose, Creating With Passion
about.description1: Driven by the belief that creativity is a language beyond words, I seek to craft visuals that communicate with purpose and authenticity.
about.description2: Whether designing social media campaigns, creating visual identities, editing videos, or developing marketing materials, my goal is always the same—to create meaningful experiences that connect with people.
